item.title: Historic Grand Rapids church the backdrop of new Netflix comedy special
item.description: Star comedian Taylor Tomlinson is set to debut a new comedy special with a historic Grand Rapids church serving as the setting.

item.title: Addiction recovery group hosts benefit concert, silent auction fundraiser

item.title: Gala supports nonprofit for families navigating the mental health system
item.description: A nonprofit that helps student-athletes and their families navigate the mental health system is getting ready for its annual fundraising gala.

item.title: Fairs, harness racers push for state bills supporting sport in Allegan County
item.description: Harness racers and county fair leaders are calling on state lawmakers to move forward with a bill aimed at supporting both industries through online gambling taxes.

item.title: Rescuers race to save 6 skiers trapped by California avalanche that's left 10 more missing
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Rescue crews on skis and snowcats battled blizzard conditions in an effort to reach six backcountry skiers still alive but trapped Tuesday after an avalanche high in the rugged Northern California mountains that left 10 other skiers missing as the danger of more slides remained high. item.title: Immigration attorneys challenge ICE arrests in West Michigan
item.description: Immigration attorneys across the country are turning to a rarely used legal move as immigrant detention hits historic highs under President Donald Trump’s second term.

item.title: Part of US-131 closed to investigate overpass after bales of hay fly off truck

item.description: Salons and barbershops are where people go for a fresh cut, but they're also a place where impactful conversations happen.

item.title: Grand Rapids mayor calls on residents to help shovel sidewalks
item.description: A call to action from Grand Rapids Mayor David LaGrand is gaining traction online. The post was an effort to get the community to help clear up the rest of the snow left over from a series of heavy snow days.
